archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Wild Arms: Digital Bros lists ARMED FANTASIA cancellation

entries.headline: Wild Arms: Digital Bros financial report lists ARMED FANTASIA development as cancelled
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Digital Bros listed ARMED FANTASIA among cancelled development projects in its annual report published on September 24 local time. Creators of Wild Arms are involved in the game. At the time of the article, developer WILD BUNCH Productions had not itself announced cancellation; the publisher group’s disclosure does not establish that the developer has confirmed the entire project is over.

entries.headline: 逆転裁判5 VR: Ace Attorney 5 VR announced for Meta VR devices in 2027
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Amata announced the Capcom-licensed Ace Attorney 5 VR on September 24. It is planned for 2027 on Meta Quest 3, 3S, 2, Pro and Meta VR Glasses. Hand tracking lets players take the role of Phoenix Wright and present evidence in court.

entries.headline: Stick It to the Stickman releases version 1.0 with cooperative brawling
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Devolver Digital released version 1.0 of Stick It to the Stickman on PC (Steam) on September 24. Developed by Free Lives, the physics-based roguelite has stick-figure employees brawl for the company’s top job and supports local and Remote Play Together co-op.

entries.headline: スクジサマ: Sukujisama horror project sets September 27 release
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that developer Rentaka announced on September 24 that the Sukujisama investigation project is planned for September 27 on PC (Steam), having passed store review. Players examine material left by a deceased occult writer in a mock-documentary horror experience. The previous window was late September.

entries.headline: Forza Horizon 6 conduct update stresses human review rather than report volume
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Turn 10 updated the Forza Code of Conduct on September 24, explaining that user-generated content is reviewed by human moderators and report counts do not affect priority or queue placement. This is the official explanation amid disputes over livery bans and coordinated reports; it does not settle individual cases.

entries.headline: Marathon roadmap plans permanent PvE and Team Deathmatch in December
entries.summary: IGN relays Bungie’s new Marathon roadmap: a Nightfall refresh in October, followed by Symbiosis in December with the first permanent PvE mode, Team Deathmatch and an expanded Perimeter. A larger anniversary update next March is planned to connect modes and improve onboarding. These are development plans; existing extraction modes remain.

entries.headline: Luma Island announces PS5 version with four-player cross-platform co-op
entries.summary: Feel Free Games announces on PlayStation Blog that Luma Island is coming to PS5. Players can build, farm and explore alone or in online groups of up to four, with cross-platform play across PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC. The original announcement gives no PS5 release date.

entries.headline: Chicken Invaders Collection opens Xbox and Windows PC Insider preview
entries.summary: Xbox Wire announces that Xbox Insiders can preview InterAction studios’ Chicken Invaders Collection on Xbox consoles and Windows PC. Participants can submit Insider Hub surveys to help the team prepare the collection for release. This is a preview, not the full release.
